chunk_map.heading: Name the likely failure and Monday move
Take the transferable move with you

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 0 line 5 names "The technical and people plans" before chunk 1's expanded prompt refers to "these plans".
The body names its input artifacts in prompt text and names module-7 files directly; no source is referenced by positional label.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No backward-beat construction of the form "the X you did/saw/caught" appears in the body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess/predict-before-reveal instruction appears in the body.
Each chunk carries a standalone action or claim: test assumptions, imagine failure and choose a Monday move, then generalize the transferable move.
The headings accurately summarize their chunks: assumptions, likely failure plus Monday move, and the transferable close.
No banned Not-X/Not-Y/Z construction, self-grading superlative, number retraction, empty verb triplet, or abstraction-noun stack appears in the body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The body uses student-facing terms such as assumptions, failure stories, incumbent, conversation, and test; no repo-internal judge vocabulary is used communicatively.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Bold is limited to the Prompt label and the selected-row handle; narrative sentences and bullets are not uniformly bolded.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The current Module 7 file includes this exercise at curriculum/trainings/agents-101/personal-to-team.md line 48; the target expands to four body chunks.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No Phase N or numbered step heading/reference appears in the body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No below/above/page-position pointer appears; the body uses sequence words such as "Then" and names each artifact directly.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No structural or in-deck link appears in the body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/exercises/test-the-sharing-plan.md reports 3 slides, oversized: 0, and every slide within limits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All three ## headings are exercise imperatives: "Test the switch assumptions", "Name the likely failure and Monday move", and "Take the transferable move with you".
